summary: Iteration 7 e2e testing: (1) Public course detail — CoursesPage cards link to /kursus/:id; course_utbk has 2 syllabus items + Tim Pengajar fallback; course_phys shows tutor 'Rina Wijaya, S.Pd'; invalid id -> 404 UI. (2) Admin notifications — pending student registration causes admin-bell + admin-bell-badge + pending-alert to appear on /admin dashboard; bell click navigates to /admin/users; after cleanup (pending=0) badge & alert are removed. (3) Profile edit — all 4 roles (student/tutor/proctor/admin) can access /profile via header-profile-link and sidebar. Student phone update persists across reload. Proctor shows profile-school-name field. (4) Change password — student change + login-with-new + revert works; wrong current -> 400; short pwd -> 400. All 11 pytest backend tests passed. All UI checks passed. Cleaned up test users and reverted student demo password.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_public.get_course_detail: tutor query filter uses status $ne 'rejected' which correctly excludes rejected tutors but still includes 'pending' tutors. Consider requiring status == 'approved' to avoid leaking unverified tutors publicly.
AdminBell polls /api/admin/pending-count every 30s; acceptable but a websocket/SSE would be nicer for real-time.
routes_auth.change_password: allows a Google user (no password_hash) to SET a password without any second-factor check — acceptable since user must already be authenticated, but worth flagging.
seed_data_creation: Registered temporary pending users (pending_iter7_*, test_iter7_*) during pending-flow testing and deleted them via DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}. Student demo password was changed to TempPwd@9876 and reverted back to Siswa@12345.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 7 (Admin bell, public course detail, profile edit + change password) is fully verified end-to-end and needs no rework. Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_features.py. Student portal path is /student (not /siswa); proctor is /proctor; admin is /admin. Bell click uses react-router navigate — use await wait_for_url or short timeout after click; do not rely on 'load' event.
